sentences.text: At ten fifteen you take two bearings: a light bears three four zero true, and a tower bears zero six five true.
Through the light, draw a line along the bearing.
Your boat is on the side toward you, along the reciprocal, one six zero.
Through the tower, draw the second line; your boat is along its reciprocal, two four five.
The lines are eighty-five degrees apart, nearly ideal, and they cross at your ten fifteen fix.
Circle it, label it, and read its latitude and longitude from the scales.
